name: Unwip 0.43.43
body:
Main screen:
- Unwip opens on the main screen on every device instead of jumping straight into your last book. "Continue" takes you back to where you left off.
- Phone and iPad: a book with changes that aren't in Dropbox yet shows "● Not synced yet" on its card until you sync.
